site.name: Hidden AI Instructions Watch
site.description: Free scanner and evidence log for web pages that hide text from people but address AI agents.

overview.name: Hidden AI Instructions Watch
overview.summary: Check whether a web page hides text from people that AI agents will still read. The free scanner is on the Apify Store and in panda-web-security-tools. This site and repo host an evidence-only log of public pages, with method and a corrections process.
